customAnalyses.description: Thirty-day terminal AgentRun duration and cost inputs by namespace, agent, provider, and observed model using retained control-plane snapshots. Duration uses observed start and finish, not queue time. Token sums cover only runs with recorded telemetry. The migrations do not store billed USD; billed_cost_usd is unknown, not zero.
customAnalyses.name: AgentRun duration and cost inputs by agent and model
customAnalyses.sql:
WITH completed AS (
  SELECT namespace,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(spec_agent_ref_name, ''), 'unknown') AS agent,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(runner_provider, ''), 'unknown') AS provider,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(runner_model, ''), 'unknown') AS model,
    NULLIF(started_at, '')::timestamptz AS started_at,
    NULLIF(finished_at, '')::timestamptz AS finished_at,
    input_tokens::numeric AS input_tokens,
    cached_input_tokens::numeric AS cached_input_tokens,
    cache_write_input_tokens::numeric AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    output_tokens::numeric AS output_tokens
  FROM agents_audit.agent_run_activity
  WHERE status_phase IN ('Succeeded', 'Failed', 'Cancelled')
    AND resource_updated_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30 days'
)
SELECT namespace, agent, provider, model, COUNT(*) AS terminal_runs,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE finished_at >= started_at) AS runs_with_duration,
  ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM finished_at - started_at)) FILTER (WHERE finished_at >= started_at), 2) AS mean_duration_seconds,
  COUNT(input_tokens) AS runs_with_token_usage, SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  SUM(cached_input_tokens) AS cached_input_tokens, SUM(cache_write_input_tokens) AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, NULL::numeric AS billed_cost_usd
FROM completed
GROUP BY namespace, agent, provider, model
ORDER BY terminal_runs DESC, namespace, agent, provider, model
LIMIT 100

customAnalyses.description: Fourteen-day failed AgentRun counts by namespace and runtime from retained control-plane snapshots. Groups structured status reasons without returning raw messages, prompts, or run identities.
customAnalyses.name: AgentRun failure taxonomy
customAnalyses.sql:
SELECT namespace, COALESCE(spec_runtime_type, 'unknown') AS runtime,
  CASE
    WHEN failure_reason IN ('MissingAgent', 'MissingImplementation', 'MissingProvider', 'MissingRuntime', 'MissingEndpoint', 'MissingMemory', 'MissingTemporalConfig', 'MissingWorkloadImage', 'RuntimeConfigMapMissing', 'WorkflowConfigMapMissing', 'ProviderNotReady') THEN 'configuration'
    WHEN failure_reason IN ('SecretBlocked', 'SecretNotAllowed', 'ServiceAccountNotAllowed', 'ImplementationSourceProviderNotAllowed', 'SpecImmutableViolation') THEN 'policy'
    WHEN failure_reason IN ('TimedOut', 'WorkflowStepTimedOut') THEN 'timeout'
    WHEN failure_reason IN ('JobFailed', 'JobMissing', 'WorkflowJobMissing', 'RunnerFailed', 'SubmitFailed', 'TemporalError', 'WorkflowLoopConditionError', 'WorkflowStepFailed', 'WorkflowStepRetriesExhausted', 'Terminated') THEN 'execution'
    WHEN NULLIF(failure_reason, '') IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS failure_category,
  COUNT(*) AS failed_runs
FROM agents_audit.agent_run_activity
WHERE status_phase = 'Failed'
  AND resource_updated_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '14 days'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY failed_runs DESC, namespace, runtime, failure_category
LIMIT 100

customAnalyses.description: Thirty-day rerun submissions by parent namespace, run attempt, and current submission status. Distinct parent counts and submission_attempt show repeated intake separately from execution outcomes.
customAnalyses.name: AgentRun rerun patterns
customAnalyses.sql:
SELECT parent_agent_run_namespace, attempt, status, COUNT(*) AS rerun_submissions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT parent_ref) AS distinct_parents,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE submission_attempt > 1) AS retried_submissions
FROM agents_audit.agent_run_rerun_submissions
WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY parent_agent_run_namespace, attempt, status
ORDER BY rerun_submissions DESC, parent_agent_run_namespace, attempt, status
LIMIT 100

customAnalyses.description: Lookup coverage of active engineering memory by note namespace. last_accessed_at records the latest retrieval only, not how many times a note was used or whether it influenced a run.
customAnalyses.name: Memory note reuse
customAnalyses.sql:
SELECT task_name AS note_namespace, COUNT(*) AS active_notes,
  COUNT(last_accessed_at) AS notes_ever_retrieved,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE last_accessed_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30 days') AS notes_retrieved_in_30_days
FROM agents_audit.memory_notes
WHERE retired_at IS NULL
GROUP BY task_name
ORDER BY notes_retrieved_in_30_days DESC, note_namespace
LIMIT 100

rules.description: Use Conventional Commits and matching PR titles in the form <type>(<scope>): <summary>. Stage only owned paths and link the issue if there is one. Follow AGENTS.md and the repository PR template.
rules.name: Conventional Commits

rules.description: Promote reviewed main builds via immutable images, the owning Warehouse and Freight, and the authorized Stage. Argo CD reconciles the exact kargo/<stage> revision. Never bypass this with manual image retagging or a direct deployment. See docs/release-automation.md.
rules.name: Kargo promotion

rules.description: Do not poll CI, reviews, or rollouts in shell loops. Use bounded readback at the delivery decision or the owning event-driven mechanism. Report pending gates as pending.
rules.name: No polling loops

rules.description: Use the authorized read-only Auto Ontology interface and a least-privileged source role. Publish only reviewed, bounded SELECTs over migration-backed tables. Do not expose credential, prompt, message, or raw payload fields in results.
rules.name: Read-only SQL

rules.description: Never put credentials, raw logs, tokens, or personal data in logs, retained artifacts, knowledge proposals, or a PR. Use sanitized evidence and keep credentials on their existing secret path.
rules.name: Secret-free evidence

rules.description: The 32 GiB RAM tmpfs AgentRun profile has a 32 GiB mount ceiling, not 32 GiB of usable process memory. Check the mount and container limits before large installs or builds, keep headroom, and remove temporary files. Lower provider and ARC limits still apply.
rules.name: tmpfs workspace budget
